# solo-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-core-ref

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`solo` with the frozen reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, `medium` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap) on `core`, a 10-pair subset of harder pairs, 3 of which have both features changing the same function. The only earlier `core` runs used a 100-step limit that stopped every `solo` agent, so this is the first `solo` result on `core` with enough budget. It is the reference for `coop --git` on the same pairs.

## Observations

- 6/10 (60%), vs. 5/10 in the earlier 100-step run (`high` thinking, 28K compaction), where every agent hit the step limit. No agent came near the limit here (median 83.5 steps).
- All 3 pairs where both features change the same function still failed, each with one feature passing: `dspy_task/8563` (1,4) and `go_chi_task/27` (3,4) passed only feature B, and `react_hook_form_task/153` (2,6) only feature A. These pairs are hard even for one agent that sees both features.
- The other failure was `pallets_click_task/2800` (1,4) (feature A only). Newly passing compared with the 100-step run: `pallets_jinja_task/1621` (6,10).
- Cost `$14.02` (`$1.40` per pair), 91 minutes at 8 pairs at a time, 17 retries.
